name: graphwing-pr-drive
description: Hard-coded PR driver using the declared trigger inputs documented in the catalog: one bounded run reserves and settles each attempt through a capped in-run retry loop (up to three slots; a slot re-reads normalized pr-policy-inputs-v1 facts, applies native review/check actionability, holds failed PR Audit transport as review infrastructure, and after a correction waits for exact-head audit evidence before another writer), then a fresh remote-state gate terminates policy-held or otherwise non-ready PRs before any callback wait; ready PRs run one final head-bound named test and persisted evidence gate before optional merge. Every attempt is run-control reservation-backed; start after graphwing-run-control-initialize with run_control_id. The webhook/doorbell start is a known-disabled operator path because current webhook runs do not create CTX.INPUT.

pr_number.description: PR number. Named pr_number because a plain pr input never reaches the workflow input context.

class.description: mechanical | visual | sensitive; absent means mechanical

work_kind.description: go_coding, typescript_coding, or research_ops; absent preserves the existing Codex route

run_control_id.description: graphwing-run-control-initialize's identity for this PR-drive attempt.

instruction.value: Fix only the listed actionable findings and root-cause checks for this exact PR head. Preserve unrelated changes and run the repository-required tests.

config._comment: Without these the writer takes AGENT_RUN_BUDGET=300 and is SIGINTed at 300+60. Three laps ran 260s, 335s and 363s, so a fix round is L-sized work, not M. wait is 960, which clears 600+60 with room.
